correctness.rationale: For each product facet (i,a), masses are m_a V/V_i; internal conductances are c_ab V/V_i; cross-factor conductances are m_a m_b V/(V_i V_j). The divergence identity sum_a m_a=d_i V_i gives the exact normalized block Laplacian. Its mass-orthogonal centered-factor and block-constant subspaces exhaust the even facet space, giving the full spectral formula with multiplicities. An explicit cross-polytope Walsh calculation yields the prism corollary. All-dimensional proof is analytic; 26 exact rational graph tests passed from verify.py.

residual_risks: A classical normalized weighted-graph join theorem combined with an unindexed preexisting geometric product identification could imply this result under other terminology.
